pick.name: Remote Control
pick.what: Continue local sessions from the Claude mobile app
pick.free_limits: Requires a Claude plan (Pro/Max plans/Team/Enterprise) or API billing; counts against plan usage

best_free.name: Happy (slopus)
best_free.what: Open-source mobile/web client that wraps the Claude Code CLI with end-to-end encrypted sync
best_free.why: Works with plain Claude Code (no other desktop hub needed); iOS, Android and web; MIT
best_free.free_limits: Free; agent usage still bills to your Claude plan or API key
best_free.install: npm install -g happy; then run happy claude and pair the phone app

alts.name: Claude Code on the web / Projects
alts.what: Cloud sessions that run with your machine off
alts.free_limits: Requires a Claude plan (Pro/Max plans/Team/Enterprise) or API billing; counts against plan usage

alts.name: Happy
alts.what: Open-source multi-agent client with mobile, web and desktop apps
alts.why: Third-party remote control without Anthropic's app
alts.free_limits: free; uses your own Claude subscription

decision: Remote Control is first-party and covers live sessions; use cloud sessions for work that must run with your machine off (no local plugins/LSP there). Happy is the free open-source alternative; Orca's mobile companion makes sense only for those who already run Orca as their desktop hub.

verify.note: Shallow check: no neutrality, pricing or licence defect found; not re-fetched.
